files.description: Viewport screenshot of the top of the FHIR specifications page showing the navigation menu with all 16 resource types and the beginning of the AllergyIntolerance documentation.
Raw structured data extracted from the FHIR specifications page via Chrome DevTools evaluate_script. Contains 16 FHIR resource definitions with fields and search parameters.
Deduplicated and normalized FHIR resource definitions: 16 resources, 131 unique fields, search parameters. Produced by extract-fhir-specs.ts from the browser extract.
Extraction statistics: resource counts, field counts per resource, parse failures, and known limitations.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that processes the browser-extracted JSON into deduplicated, normalized FHIR resource definitions.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output files, known parsing limitations.
